checkpoints.quote: a mobile-web account transfer retried after a timeout ERR_TXN_504 results in the source account being debited twice while the destination is credited once
checkpoints.reason: The analysis clearly states the double-debit/single-credit outcome of retrying after ERR_TXN_504.

checkpoints.quote: Affects version: 3.1.4. Fix version: 3.2.0. Target release noted by Aroha Walker 2026-09-11 is 2026-09-24.
checkpoints.reason: All three elements (affects 3.1.4, fix in 3.2.0, release date 2026-09-24) are explicitly stated.

checkpoints.quote: Priya Nair identifies two problems: no idempotency key on retry and debit/credit not atomic.
checkpoints.reason: Both root causes (missing idempotency key and non-atomic debit/credit) are clearly stated as identified by Priya.

checkpoints.quote: Status: In Progress. Assignee: Priya Nair. Reporter: Marcus Reid. … PR #218 is open per Priya Nair 2026-09-12 16:40. It wraps debit and credit in a single DB transaction and adds Idempotency-Key header support to POST /api/transaction/transfer. Waiting on code review.
checkpoints.reason: Status, assignee, and PR #218 waiting on code review are all explicitly stated.

checkpoints.quote: Aroha Walker 2026-09-11 states Finance will need to reverse duplicate debits for the three affected customers manually and asks Marcus Reid to raise with Finance Ops.
checkpoints.reason: Three customers, manual reversal by Finance, and Marcus Reid being asked to raise with Finance Ops are all conveyed.

checkpoints.quote: No confirmation that this has been done.
checkpoints.reason: The analysis explicitly notes the ticket does not confirm the reversal has been raised or completed.

checkpoints.quote: Priya Nair: expedite code review for PR #218 before Sprint 38 ends 2026-09-22 to meet 3.2.0 target 2026-09-24. … Marcus Reid: confirm with Finance Ops that manual reversals for the three customers from support calls on 5, 6 and 8 September are raised and tracked, as requested by Aroha Walker.
checkpoints.reason: Both next actions (get PR #218 reviewed/merged and confirm reversals with Finance Ops) are listed.
The analysis correctly states PR #218 is open and waiting on code review; it never claims it has been merged, deployed, or released.
The analysis correctly reports that desktop web does not reproduce the issue, consistent with the ticket.
